heading: Failure by broker to provide notice to payors

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Any person required under section 3406(d)(2)(B) to provide notice to any payor who willfully fails to provide such notice to such payor shall pay a penalty of $500 for each such failure.

tree.heading: Penalty in addition to other penalties
tree.text: Any penalty imposed by this section shall be in addition to any other penalty provided by law.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective with respect to payments made after Dec. 31, 1983, see section 110(a) of Pub. L. 98–67, set out as an Effective Date of 1983 Amendment note under section 31 of this title.
